rationale: FAMILY SUBSTITUTION: codex capacity-failed again; this round-4 verdict is a Claude substitute in the R5 seat, continuing my round-1/2/3 sub verdicts. Reviewed f6847729 in the bead worktree; worktree left byte-identical; full `go test ./... -short` green. ROUND-3 ASK CLASSIFICATION (both mine, both re-derived): Ask 1 (enumerate branch candidates from fully qualified refnames, never %(refname:short)) = ADDRESSED — the new gitutil.LocalBranchNames uses `git for-each-ref --format=%(refname:lstrip=2) refs/heads`, and `lstrip=2` unconditionally strips exactly the two 'refs/heads/' path segments with no ambiguous-short-name disambiguation ever applied (equivalent in effect to my suggested %(refname)+TrimPrefix form; the implementer's variant is fine — the property that matters is determinism under a same-named tag, which the gitutil unit test pins directly, including asserting the 'heads/spec/<id>' disambiguated form never appears). DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache is switched to LocalBranchNames at its sole branch-enumeration site (resolve.go:164), with the CutPrefix now operating on true branch names. Verified empirically end-to-end: my EXACT round-3 repro fixture (branch-only draft spec/055-branch-only + same-named tag at main + healthy fake bd), which printed {"mode":"idle"} exit 0 at a86d0bdd, now renders {"mode":"spec","activeSpec":"055-branch-only","specBranch":"spec/055-branch-only"} with a binary rebuilt at f6847729. Ask 2 (regression tests at the vulnerable layer) = ADDRESSED — three layers now pinned: the gitutil primitive (TestLocalBranchNames_RealGit_SurvivesShadowTag, with a sensible skip-guard control if a git version's :short doesn't disambiguate), DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache (TestDiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache_BranchOnlyDraft_ShadowTagDoesNotHideIt, using the real spec-create-shaped branch-only fixture), and the full ambient state-show surface (TestStateShow_AmbientMainCheckout_BranchOnlyDraft_ShadowTagDoesNotHideIt) — exactly the enumeration-bypassing gap I flagged; all pass. SWEEP OF THE NEW CODE: the sibling-function decision (LocalBranchNames beside LocalBranchRefs rather than changing it in place) is sound and honestly disclosed — LocalBranchRefs sits in the Executor interface and has two other direct consumers (internal/layout/precondition.go, internal/lifecycle/finalize_orphans.go) outside this bead's reviewed scope; the one remaining %(refname:short) residue (RemoteTrackingRefs, migrate-layout only, no draft-discovery path) is disclosed and reported rather than silently patched, which is the right call. The new ratchet argv entry for LocalBranchNames is honest: Count 1 matches the single exec site, and its opClassStringLiteral classification is accurate — the argv is entirely fixed literals plus workdir via -C, with no dynamic ref/branch/id operand (correctly a different class from the RejectOptionLike-gated wrappers). My rounds-1-3 verified surfaces are undisturbed: the qualified-ref tree probe, the G1 flag-propagation guards, the ADR-0035 discovery-failure refusals, and the multi-draft ambiguity rendering all still pass their tests in this run.

findings.summary: Round-3 ask 1 ADDRESSED: LocalBranchNames' %(refname:lstrip=2) enumeration is deterministic under a same-named shadow tag (lstrip strips exactly refs/heads/, never disambiguates); DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache switched at its sole enumeration site. My exact round-3 end-to-end repro — which fabricated bare idle at a86d0bdd — now renders the honest {"mode":"spec"} draft representation with a binary rebuilt at f6847729.

Round-3 ask 2 ADDRESSED: shadow-tag regressions now pinned at all three layers (gitutil primitive with a version-tolerant control, DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache with the real branch-only fixture, and the ambient state-show surface), closing the enumeration-bypass gap the round-2 test had.

Disclosed scope handling verified sound: LocalBranchRefs deliberately preserved for its Executor-interface and layout/lifecycle consumers (changing its output shape would be an unreviewed behavior change to three out-of-scope callers); the RemoteTrackingRefs %(refname:short) residue is out of every draft-discovery path, disclosed, and escalated to the orchestrator rather than silently patched. The new ratchet argv entry is accurate (fixed-literal argv, Count 1, correctly classified).
